answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Shares & Investments Question ID: 44536 Country: Bangladesh Title: Shares Question: I did not know about the severe things about investing money in share business of a bank. Now I know that we should not invest in banks. The money I have invested are really important to me. What can I do now? Can I use the money without the profit? Or the whole capital also became haram for me? Answer ID: 44536 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 497/392/B=1434) You can withdraw and use as much amount as you have invested in it. You can withdraw whatever extra amount you can get also but you should give it to poor, needy ones or debtors etc without the intention of reward. It is not lawful for you to take the extra amount for your personal use. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
